name: Rascally Rodents

choiceRewards.name: Mining for Dummies
tooltip: Use: Increases your Mining skill by 2. Cannot raise Mining skill over 15. You will learn Mining if it is not already trained and you do not already know two other professions.
"Explains how to mine using only the ten hundred most common words."

choiceRewards.name: Wild Harvest
tooltip: Use: Increases your Herbalism skill by 2. Cannot raise Herbalism skill over 15. You will learn Herbalism if it is not already trained and you do not already know two other professions.
"An instruction manual for picking wild herbs."

choiceRewards.name: Pelt Collecting for Beginners
tooltip: Use: Increases your Skinning skill by 2. Cannot raise Skinning skill over 15. You will learn Skinning if it is not already trained and you do not already know two other professions.
"A picture book documenting how to collect animal skins."

narrative.details: Those awful kobolds are eating my books! You have to get them back before they devour my whole library.
narrative.objectives: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.
narrative.offerRewardText: Thank you so much! Here! Take one of these how-to books. I don't need them.But there's still so many books missing. The kobolds don't seem to be eating them. So, why do they want them?
narrative.requestItemsText: Have you rescued my books yet, Braiknok?!

chain.subtitle: 8 quests from level 2 to 7, 2,630 XP in all.

quests.name: Nibbled-On Book
quests.objectiveText: Return the book to Brother Paxton.

quests.name: Rascally Rodents
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve 8 Stolen Books from kobolds in Northshire Valley and return them to Brother Paxton.

quests.name: Mining Consultant
quests.objectiveText: Talk to Kelsey Fargo outside the Echo Ridge Mine in Northshire Valley.

quests.name: The Big Picture
quests.objectiveText: Retrieve a Sack of "Picture" Books from Shinyfinder Narf.

quests.name: Follow That Kobold!
quests.objectiveText: Speak to Tordrin Sternblade near the stable behind Northshire's Abbey.

quests.name: Shhh! We're Hunting Kobolds
quests.objectiveText: Follow the kobold tracks and report to Marshal Dughan in Goldshire with your findings and the Kobold Tracking Kit.

quests.name: Book Return
quests.objectiveText: Find 6 Lost Books and "Fun with Elementals" and return them to Marshal Dughan.

quests.name: Rare Books
quests.objectiveText: Recover "Geomancy for Curious Young Wizards" and "Arcane Explainer: Magical Stuff in Simple Words" and return them to Brother Paxton inside Northshire's Abbey.
